Should I spawn a parallel cloud session for BK-401 now, and on which base?

options.label: Spawn on master (Recommended)
options.description: Independent PR, merges in any order with BUG-301. Session gets the brief: P6 re-measure (Stage-2, --cov-append), switch six targets to sysmon, leave test-cov-branch, reserved ID BK-409, trace, no PR until you ask. Expect one trivial BACKLOG/BACKLOG-DONE conflict for whoever merges second.

options.label: Spawn stacked on BUG-301
options.description: Same brief, but branched from bug-301-pii-regex-anchor so test-cassette-pii timings reflect the fixed regex. Its PR must wait for BUG-301 to merge, then rebase onto master.

options.label: Don't spawn; do it here after
options.description: Finish BUG-301 here first (gate result, PR if you want one), then do BK-401 sequentially in this session. No conflicts, slower overall.
